author: New China TV
description:
In commemoration of the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Long March, Xinhua presents this video, bringing to life the voices and memories of the Red Army veterans who lived through it.
Though they have passed away, their voices live on. Through their memories, we revisit a journey marked by unimaginable hardship, sacrifice, and unwavering faith. From fierce battles to snow-covered mountains and treacherous grasslands, their stories bring the Long March to life and remind us of a spirit that continues to echo across generations.
title: Last Voices of the Long Marchers

description: Five years after its official establishment, the Northeast China Tiger and Leopard National Park has restored 40,000 hectares of habitat. U.S. President Donald Trump declared Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an immediate "energy ceasefire," but Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he was unaware of such an agreement.

description:
Sanjiangyuan National Park turns 5!
Formally established on Oct. 12, 2021, the park protects the headwaters of the Yangtze, Yellow and Lancang rivers. Five years on, wildlife protection continues, local rangers remain on the front lines, and water bodies and wetland ecosystems are expanding.
Here's a look at five years of protecting China's "water tower."
#Sanjiangyuan #Wildlife #Conservation #China
title: Sanjiangyuan National Park turns 5

author: New China TV
description:
Iran's #IRGC says a #supertanker struck a naval mine south of the Strait of #Hormuz on Sunday, triggering an explosion and a fire in its engine room.
According to the IRGC, the crude oil tanker had switched off its navigation systems and attempted to leave the strait via an unauthorized route, "violating maritime regulations."
This is the third tanker to hit a sea mine near the Strait of Hormuz in less than 48 hours.

Footage: Iran's state news agency #IRNA
title: Iran's IRGC says "violating" supertanker caught fire after hitting mine in Hormuz Strait

description:
Tucked away in Sanya, Hainan Province, this genetic treasure vault of rice holds boundless potential.
By gathering more than 15,000 wild rice samples, the facility enables scientists to mix ancient survival traits, such as drought and extreme temperature resistance, with modern crops, breeding the ultimate climate-resilient rice for the future.
title: Eyes on Hainan | A peek into world's largest wild rice germplasm resources nursery
